title: ID0447717-DC/Si-D/GB-[MP / P1 170000136] OCPP Backend Issue
description:
Reported Behavior/ Issue: OCPP Backend Issue
Solution: FW version had more than 50 characters - not accepted - change FW version name to have less than 50 characters

additional_info.subject: Issue description
additional_info.body:
OCPP backend is not seeing the charger come online.
Bootnotification receives ValidationFailure error which means I
believe the error is internal - that is, there's not enough time for
the notification to go to the backend, error, and come back.
Send BootNotification 2025-09-03T13:57:45.43609
